description.value: The Gallery at Queen's Park is a public art gallery housed in the historic Centennial Lodge inside Queen's Park, operated by Arts New West on behalf of the City of New Westminster since 1985. It hosts twelve exhibitions per year featuring two- and three-dimensional works by emerging and established artists from across Metro Vancouver. The park setting makes it a pleasant cultural detour for cyclists passing through New Westminster.
